notes.title: Update! Dashing out of attack recovery animation + Performance Improvements
notes.content: [p]A few updates based on feedback.[/p][list][*][p]Now able to dash out of the attack recovery animation. Pressing dash after using the basic attack will let you instantly dash away or towards your target. (Thanks Tim!)[/p][/*][*][p]1 old save file will be kept alongside the main save and backup files. Just in case you made a mistake and the autosave kicked in before you could quit the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Billboard light Placement. The lights align with the billboard again.[/p][/*][*][p]General performance improvements. HOPING that this makes the game run better and at a locked 60fps (For Steam Deck at the very least).[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're having any issues please let me know.[/p][p]That's all for now! [/p][p][/p]

notes.content: Optimized particle effects to be less resource hungry

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
The Wind’s Path Demo on Steam has been updated with some badly needed fixes.
Endless Project Games is still accepting feedback from anyone who plays the demo. So don’t be shy!

These fixes include the following:
[list]
[*] New tutorial - Added a new tutorial to teach players more of the game’s mechanics.
[*] Smoother Difficulty - Eased some of the entry levels to ease players into the main game. 
[*] Increased Attack Range - The basic wind attack has an increased range. This makes attacking enemies slightly safer because the player can attack from farther back now.
[*] Updated Capsule Art

[/list]
